contexts.text: This would be to destroy the whole man.

The external man destroyed by cupidities of evil and persuasions of falsity. Signified. For these two are what destroy the external man... and these two were what destroyed the Most Ancient Church... When these two reign, the whole external man is destroyed, and when it is destroyed it is also separated from the internal.
Nothing is more delightful to them than thus to destroy man.
They are most delighted to destroy the conscience.
Nothing but self-love endeavours to destroy this form and this order... Thus they destroy everything unanimous and sociable; hence disunion, and consequently, destruction.
Hence it is evident that self-love is not only destructive of the human race, but also that it is destructive of heavenly order.
(The causes of the destruction of Churches.)
I have destroyed them in my wrath () = victories over falsities.
To smite = to destroy.
To spoil = to destroy.
Hell, being in the opposite, destroys all things.
An estranged Scientific endeavouring to destroy the truth of the Church. Signified.
To smite = to endeavour to destroy.
The infernals continually burn to destroy the things of Heaven...
The endeavour to destroy the Church. Signified.
Such destruction not with others in the natural mind. Signified.
The reason they cannot destroy these things...
The east wind = a means of destruction.
To destroy () = to reject as nothing.
That from power Heaven is destroyed. Signified.
To drive out = to cast down, and thus to destroy.
They suppose themselves able to destroy Heaven itself; for all in the Hells... are thence in the continual cupidity of destroying it.
The will to destroy Heaven... is not effected by a hostile invasion... but by the destruction of the truth of faith and the good of love.
Such things as are to be avoided, because they destroy and deprive. Signified and Explained.
It treats in this chapter of those things which injure or destroy the truth of faith or the good of charity with one's self or with others. AC 8971.
To destroy falsities with such is to destroy the life itself. Explained.

Destroying thou wilt destroy them () = that evils are to be entirely removed... The reason to destroy = to remove, is that they who are in good and truth never destroy those who are in evil and falsity, but only remove them; the reason being that they act from good and not from evil, and good is from the Lord, Who never destroys anyone: whereas they who are in evil and thence in falsity endeavour to destroy, and so far as they can, do destroy those who are in good; the reason being that they act from evil. But as they then rush against the good which is from the Lord, thus against the Divine, they destroy themselves, that is, precipitate themselves into condemnation and into Hell.
The reason the Israelites and Jews destroyed the nations of the Land of Canaan. Explained.
Hence it is evident, that the former life, which is of Hell, is to be entirely destroyed, that is, evils and falsities are to be removed...
Hence it is evident, that the life of Hell with man cannot be suddenly destroyed...
For the Hells continually breathe what is evil, and endeavour to destroy Heaven.
That which disjoins also destroys; hence, in the opposite sense, salt = the destruction and devastation of truth and good. Illustrated.
As it destroys truth and good, it is called a waste to eternity.
Hence it is evident that by salt... in the opposite sense is signified the longing of falsity for evil, thus what is destructive.
To smite = to destroy; and in the spiritual sense to destroy is to deprive some one of the truths and goods of faith and love, which in the Word is called desolation and vastation.
Such things with many destroy faith in the life after death... That they have destroyed it is evident...
These loves are destructive of the delights with others.
Wherefore, the delight of their life is to will to destroy and kill them...

The sphere issuing from the Hells is entirely a sphere of endeavours to destroy the Divine of the Lord, and thus Heaven. The ebullitions of some of the Hells were perceived, which were endeavours to emerge and to destroy.
(Title). On the Last Judgment, and on the Babylon destroyed.
How they were destroyed, and their habitations made a desert. Described.
To confirm falsities even to the destruction of genuine truth condemns. DSS 96.
Such a man is therefore destroyed as to all that is truly human. Explained.
That they have utterly destroyed (the truths of the Word) by applications to falsities. Signified.
The unbridled love of self... is destructive of love to the Lord; and the unbridled love of the world... is destructive of love towards the neighbour.
The Church with the Israelitish nation was utterly destroyed through falsifications of the Word. Signified.
The Church is such as is the understanding of the Word in it... destroyed, yea, filthy, if the understanding is from truths falsified.
That the Second Advent is not to destroy anything...
On the destruction of Babel. SE 5229. SE 5249. SE 5269.
On the total destruction of Babylonia.
On the destruction of the Old Heaven.
Then began their destruction...
On the destruction of the Old Heaven and earth.
On the destruction of the subtle Spirits from the Mohammedans, Babylonians, and Reformed.
Sword in these passages = truth combating and destroying: this destruction appears especially in the Spiritual World. Explained.
The total vastation of the Church is described by the Lord hath destroyed the strongholds of the daughter of Judah ().

To destroy the high places, to destroy the altars () = to destroy all things of idolatrous worship through falsities and evils; for idolatrous worship destroys itself thereby; for sword = falsities destroying.
The destruction thereby of all the good and truth of the Church. Signified.
To overcome and kill the two witnesses = to destroy the things signified by the two witnesses...
Under Destroy, see this reference.
Destroyers and devastators () = the falsities of evil.
To destroy the cities thereof () = to destroy all things of the Church. AE 730:5. AE 1029:13.
The destruction of the falsities which originate from their evils. Signified.
Destruction even until there was nothing of truth and good remaining. Signified.
The Power of doing = the act of destroying goods and truths.
Blasphemy = the falsification of the Word even to the destruction of Divine truth.
Devastation and destruction as to all things of doctrine with them. Signified.
